blocks.text: Ot + ot: birinchi ot sifat vazifasida

Inglizchada ikki ot ketma-ket kelib, birinchisi ikkinchisini aniqlashi mumkin: a **bus** driver, a **tennis** ball, the **city** centre, **exam** results. Birinchi ot xuddi sifatdek ishlaydi (sifatlar va ularning o'rni → qizil kitob, 85-dars) — «qanday?», «nimaga oid?» savoliga javob beradi; asosiy ot esa **oxirgisi**. O'zbekchadagi izofa bilan solishtiring: «avtobus haydovchisi», «tennis to'pi», «shahar markazi», «imtihon natijalari». Tartib bir xil — avval aniqlovchi, keyin asosiy so'z; faqat inglizchada `-i / -si` qo'shimchasi yo'q. Shuning uchun bu birikmalar o'zbek o'quvchisi uchun tabiiy, xatolar esa asosan ko'plik, son va **of** bilan bog'liq.
Tartib muhim: a flower garden ≠ a garden flower

Asosiy ot doim oxirida turadi, shuning uchun so'zlar o'rnini almashtirsangiz, boshqa narsa hosil bo'ladi: a flower **garden** — gulzor (bu — bog'), a garden **flower** — bog' guli (bu — gul). Xuddi shunday: a horse **race** — ot poygasi, a race **horse** — poyga oti; milk **chocolate** — sutli shokolad, chocolate **milk** — shokoladli sut; a house**boat** — uy-qayiq, a boat**house** — qayiqxona. Tarjima qilishda avval oxirgi so'zni toping — gap aynan o'sha narsa haqida.

items.text: There's a lovely **rose garden** behind the museum.
My grandfather bred **race horses** and never missed a **horse race** in the village.
items.translation: Bobom **poyga otlari** boqardi va qishloqdagi birorta ham **ot poygasini** o'tkazib yubormasdi.

items.text: The **kitchen window** looks out onto a small **apple orchard**.

blocks.text: Bitta so'z, ikki so'z yoki chiziqcha

Ko'p birikmalar alohida yoziladi: a bus stop, a car park, a credit card, a phone charger. Eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari esa bitta so'zga aylanib ketgan: a **headache** (head + ache — bosh og'rig'i), a **toothbrush**, a **bookshop**, a **bedroom**, a **weekend**, a **website**, **sunglasses**, a **classroom**, an **earthquake**. Ba'zilari chiziqcha bilan yoziladi. Qat'iy qoida yo'q — shubha bo'lsa, lug'atga qarang; ma'no va tuzilish esa baribir bir xil: oxirgi qism asosiy.

Birikma uzaysa ham mantiq o'zgarmaydi — oxirgi ot asosiy, oldingilari uni aniqlaydi: a **city centre car park** (shahar markazidagi avtoturargoh), a **road safety campaign** (yo'l xavfsizligi aksiyasi), a **student exchange programme** (talabalar almashinuvi dasturi), **winter sports equipment** (qishki sport anjomlari). O'zbekchaga bunday zanjirlar ko'pincha `-dagi`, `-ga oid` yoki ikki izofa bilan o'giriladi. Gazeta sarlavhalarida ular ayniqsa ko'p: «Metro ticket price rise» — metro chiptasi narxining oshishi.

items.text: The **city centre car park** is full, so we'll have to park near the station.
items.translation: **Shahar markazidagi avtoturargoh** to'la, mashinani vokzal yaqiniga qo'yishga to'g'ri keladi.

items.text: Our university has a **student exchange programme** with a college in Manchester.
items.translation: Universitetimizning Manchesterdagi kollej bilan **talabalar almashinuvi dasturi** bor.

items.text: The police have launched a new **road safety campaign** for schoolchildren.
items.translation: Politsiya maktab o'quvchilari uchun yangi **yo'l xavfsizligi aksiyasini** boshladi.

blocks.text: Birinchi ot — birlikda: a shoe shop, a two-hour journey

Birinchi ot sifat vazifasida bo'lgani uchun odatda **birlikda** qoladi (sifat ham ko'plik olmaydi): a **shoe** shop («shoes shop» emas), a **ticket** office, a **book** club. Son + ot birikmasi ham shunday: chiziqcha bilan yoziladi va **`-s` olmaydi**: a **ten-pound** note, a **two-hour** journey, a **five-star** hotel, a **three-year-old** girl, a **ten-minute** walk, a **twenty-storey** building. Taqqoslang: The journey takes **two hours** (oddiy ot — ko'plik) — It's a **two-hour** journey (aniqlovchi — birlik). O'zbekchada ham shunga o'xshash: «ikki soat**lik** yo'l» — sondan keyin ot birlikda.

rows: It takes **ten minutes** to walk there.

blocks.text: Istisno: faqat ko'plikda ishlatiladigan yoki ko'plikda boshqa ma'noga ega otlar (→ 79-dars) birinchi o'rinda ham ko'plikda qoladi: a **sports** car, a **clothes** shop, a **savings** account, a **sales** manager, the **accounts** department, a **customs** officer, a **goods** train. Lekin ikki qismli narsalar birlikda: a **trouser** pocket, a **pyjama** top.
a wine glass yoki a glass of wine?

Ot + ot birikmasi narsaning **turi** yoki **vazifasini** bildiradi: a **wine glass** — vino uchun mo'ljallangan qadah (bo'sh bo'lishi ham mumkin). **of** bilan esa **ichidagi narsa** va miqdor: a **glass of wine** — bir qadah vino. Xuddi shunday: a **coffee cup** — qahva finjoni / a **cup of coffee** — bir finjon qahva; a **matchbox** — gugurt qutisi / a **box of matches** — bir quti gugurt; a **shopping bag** — xarid sumkasi / a **bag of shopping** — bir sumka xarid. O'zbekchada ham farq aniq: «choy piyolasi» va «bir piyola choy». Egalik -'s va of farqi — keyingi darsda (→ 81-dars).

items.text: Could I have **a cup of tea**? — Sure, but all the **tea cups** are in the dishwasher.
items.translation: Bir **piyola choy** bersangiz bo'ladimi? — Albatta, lekin hamma **choy piyolalari** idish yuvish mashinasida.

items.text: She came home with **a bag of shopping** in each hand.
items.translation: U har bir qo'lida **bir sumkadan xarid** bilan uyga keldi.

items.text: Keep the **matchbox** somewhere the children can't reach it.
items.translation: **Gugurt qutisini** bolalarning qo'li yetmaydigan joyda saqlang.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «a driver of bus» → **a bus driver**; «a shoes shop» → **a shoe shop**; «a two-hours trip» → **a two-hour trip**; «a ten-pounds note» → **a ten-pound note**; «a three-years-old girl» → **a three-year-old girl**; «a cup for coffee» → **a coffee cup**; qahva so'raganda «a coffee cup, please» → **a cup of coffee, please**; gulzor ma'nosida «a garden flower» → **a flower garden**; «the centre city» → **the city centre**.

Birikmani o'zbekcha izofaga aylantirib tekshiring: **bus driver** → «avtobus haydovchisi» — tartib bir xil, asosiy so'z oxirida. O'zbekchada «bir piyola ...», «bir quti ...» desangiz — **of** kerak (a cup of tea). Sondan keyin chiziqcha qo'yilgan birikmada `-s` yo'q — xuddi o'zbekcha «ikki soat**lik**» da ot birlikda qolgani kabi.

rows: a bus stop, a headache, a bookshop

examples.title: Jobs and people: **a bus driver**, **a history teacher**
examples.description: Ot + ot — kasb va odamlar: birinchi ot sohani bildiradi. O'zbekchadagi izofa: avtobus haydovchisi, tarix o'qituvchisi.

sentences.text: My uncle has been **a taxi driver** in Tashkent for over twenty years.
sentences.translation: Amakim yigirma yildan ortiq Toshkentda **taksi haydovchisi** bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Our **history teacher** made the lessons so interesting that nobody ever missed them.
sentences.translation: **Tarix o'qituvchimiz** darslarni shunchalik qiziqarli o'tardiki, hech kim ularni qoldirmasdi.

sentences.text: The **bus driver** waited for me, even though I was a minute late.
sentences.translation: Bir daqiqa kechikkan bo'lsam ham, **avtobus haydovchisi** meni kutib turdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod is a huge **football fan**, so he never misses a Pakhtakor match.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ashaddiy **futbol ishqibozi**, shuning uchun Paxtakorning birorta o'yinini qoldirmaydi.

sentences.text: Kate works as a **software engineer** for a company in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Keyt Manchesterdagi kompaniyada **dasturiy ta'minot muhandisi** bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Several **hotel workers** were rewarded for helping guests during the fire.
sentences.translation: Yong'in paytida mehmonlarga yordam bergan bir necha **mehmonxona xodimi** taqdirlandi.

sentences.text: Are you a **coffee drinker**, or do you prefer green tea like most people here?
sentences.translation: Siz **qahvaxo'rmisiz** yoki bu yerdagi ko'pchilik kabi ko'k choyni afzal ko'rasizmi?

sentences.text: The **museum guide** spoke excellent English and answered all our questions.
sentences.translation: **Muzey gidi** ingliz tilida a'lo darajada gapirdi va barcha savollarimizga javob berdi.

sentences.text: When I was a child, I dreamed of becoming a **train driver**.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda **mashinist** bo'lishni orzu qilardim.

sentences.text: Madina's brother is a **police officer**, and her sister is a **primary school teacher**.
sentences.translation: Madinaning akasi **politsiya xodimi**, opasi esa **boshlang'ich sinf o'qituvchisi**.

examples.title: Things and places: **a bus stop**, **a car park**
examples.description: Ot + ot — narsa va joylar: bekat, avtoturargoh, chipta, quvvatlagich. Birinchi ot — vazifa yoki mo'ljal, asosiy ot — oxirgisi.

sentences.text: I waited at **the bus stop** for half an hour, but the bus never came.
sentences.translation: **Avtobus bekatida** yarim soat kutdim, lekin avtobus kelmadi.

sentences.text: The **car park** at the airport is very expensive, so we took a taxi.
sentences.translation: Aeroportdagi **avtoturargoh** juda qimmat, shuning uchun taksiga o'tirdik.

sentences.text: Have you seen my **phone charger**? My battery's almost dead.
sentences.translation: **Telefon quvvatlagichimni** ko'rmadingizmi? Batareyam deyarli o'tirib qoldi.

sentences.text: You'll need two **passport photos** for the visa application.
sentences.translation: Viza arizasi uchun ikkita **pasport surati** kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: We bought our **train tickets** online because it was cheaper than at the station.
sentences.translation: **Poyezd chiptalarimizni** onlayn oldik, chunki vokzaldagidan arzonroq edi.

sentences.text: The **city centre** gets very crowded on Friday evenings.
sentences.translation: Juma kechqurunlari **shahar markazi** juda gavjum bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Don't forget your **student card** — you'll get a discount at the museum.
sentences.translation: **Talaba guvohnomangizni** unutmang — muzeyda chegirma olasiz.

sentences.text: There's a **petrol station** just after the bridge, if you need to fill up.
sentences.translation: Yoqilg'i quymoqchi bo'lsangiz, ko'prikdan keyin darrov **yoqilg'i quyish shoxobchasi** bor.

sentences.text: Aziz left his **credit card** in the restaurant and only noticed the next morning.
sentences.translation: Aziz **kredit kartasini** restoranda qoldirib ketdi va buni faqat ertasi tongda payqadi.

sentences.text: Our **exam results** will be published on the university website next Friday.
sentences.translation: **Imtihon natijalarimiz** kelasi juma universitet saytida e'lon qilinadi.

examples.title: One word: **a headache**, **a bookshop**, **a toothbrush**
examples.description: Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan ot + ot birikmalari bitta so'z bo'lib yoziladi, lekin mantiq o'sha: head + ache — bosh og'rig'i.

sentences.text: I've had a terrible **headache** since this morning, so I'm going to bed early.
sentences.translation: Ertalabdan beri **boshim** qattiq **og'riyapti**, shuning uchun erta yotaman.

sentences.text: There's a lovely old **bookshop** near the university where you can find rare books.
sentences.translation: Universitet yaqinida noyob kitoblarni topish mumkin bo'lgan ajoyib eski **kitob do'koni** bor.

sentences.text: Remember to pack your **toothbrush** and **toothpaste** — the hotel doesn't provide them.
sentences.translation: **Tish cho'tkasi** va **tish pastasini** olishni unutmang — mehmonxona ularni bermaydi.

sentences.text: Our flat has two **bedrooms** and a **bathroom** with a window.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramizda ikkita **yotoqxona** va derazali **hammom** bor.

sentences.text: What are you doing at **the weekend**? — Nothing special, just relaxing at home.
sentences.translation: **Dam olish kunlari** nima qilyapsiz? — Hech narsa, uyda dam olaman, xolos.

sentences.text: Every **classroom** in the new school has an interactive **whiteboard**.
sentences.translation: Yangi maktabdagi har bir **sinf xonasida** interaktiv **doska** bor.

sentences.text: Sarah booked the tickets through the airline's **website**, and it took two minutes.
sentences.translation: Sara chiptalarni aviakompaniya **saytida** band qildi, bunga ikki daqiqa ketdi.

sentences.text: Is there a **postbox** near here? I need to send this letter today.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga yaqin **pochta qutisi** bormi? Bu xatni bugun jo'natishim kerak.

sentences.text: The **earthquake** damaged hundreds of houses in the mountain villages.
sentences.translation: **Zilzila** tog' qishloqlaridagi yuzlab uylarga zarar yetkazdi.

sentences.text: Jasur left his **sunglasses** at the hotel, and the **sunlight** on the snow nearly blinded him.
sentences.translation: Jasur **quyosh ko'zoynagini** mehmonxonada qoldiribdi, qor ustidagi **quyosh nuri** esa ko'zini qamashtirib yuborishiga sal qoldi.

examples.title: Order matters: **a flower garden** / **a garden flower**
examples.description: Asosiy ot doim oxirida. So'zlar o'rnini almashtirsangiz, boshqa narsa hosil bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Grandma has turned the yard into a beautiful **flower garden**.
sentences.translation: Buvim hovlini chiroyli **gulzorga** aylantirib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Tulips are popular **garden flowers**, but they also grow wild in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Lola — mashhur **bog' guli**, lekin u tog'larda yovvoyi holda ham o'sadi.

sentences.text: Thousands of people come to watch the **horse race** at the spring festival.
sentences.translation: Bahor bayramidagi **ot poygasini** ko'rish uchun minglab odamlar keladi.

sentences.text: A good **race horse** can cost as much as a house.
sentences.translation: Yaxshi **poyga oti** bitta uychalik turishi mumkin.

sentences.text: I'd like a bar of **milk chocolate**, please, not dark.
sentences.translation: Menga achchiq emas, bitta **sutli shokolad** bering.

sentences.text: The kids drank **chocolate milk** after football practice.
sentences.translation: Bolalar futbol mashg'ulotidan keyin **shokoladli sut** ichishdi.

sentences.text: On holiday in India we spent three nights on a **houseboat**.
sentences.translation: Hindistondagi ta'tilimizda uch kechani **uy-qayiqda** o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: In Oxford, the rowing club keeps its boats in an old **boathouse** by the river.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda eshkak eshish klubi qayiqlarini daryo bo'yidagi eski **qayiqxonada** saqlaydi.

sentences.text: Is that a **door key** or a **car key**? — Neither, it's for the garage.
sentences.translation: Bu **eshik kalitimi** yoki **mashina kalitimi**? — Hech biri, garajniki.

sentences.text: A **coffee table** is a low table in the living room, and you don't have to drink coffee at it!
sentences.translation: **Jurnal stoli** — mehmonxonadagi past stol, uning yonida qahva ichish shart emas!

examples.title: Singular first noun: **a shoe shop** — but **a sports car**
examples.description: Birinchi ot odatda birlikda: a shoe shop, a ticket office. Faqat ko'plikda ishlatiladigan yoki ko'plikda boshqa ma'noli otlar esa ko'plikda qoladi: a sports car, a clothes shop, a savings account.

sentences.text: There's a new **shoe shop** in the mall, and everything is twenty per cent off.
sentences.translation: Savdo markazida yangi **poyabzal do'koni** ochildi, hamma narsaga yigirma foiz chegirma.

sentences.text: The **ticket office** closes at six, so we'd better hurry.
sentences.translation: **Chipta kassasi** soat oltida yopiladi, shoshilganimiz ma'qul.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has joined a **book club** where they discuss a novel every month.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza har oy bitta roman muhokama qilinadigan **kitobxonlar klubiga** qo'shildi.

sentences.text: My cousin bought a red **sports car**, and now he can't afford the petrol.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham qizil **sport mashinasi** sotib oldi, endi benzinga puli yetmayapti.

sentences.text: Emma works in a **clothes shop** in Manchester at the weekends.
sentences.translation: Emma dam olish kunlari Manchesterdagi **kiyim do'konida** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: It's a good idea to open a **savings account** as soon as you start working.
sentences.translation: Ishlay boshlashingiz bilanoq **jamg'arma hisobi** ochish yaxshi fikr.

sentences.text: Our **sales manager** has gone to Almaty to meet a new client.
sentences.translation: **Savdo bo'limi menejerimiz** yangi mijoz bilan uchrashish uchun Olmaotaga ketdi.

sentences.text: Please send the invoice to the **accounts department**, not to me.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, hisob-fakturani menga emas, **buxgalteriyaga** yuboring.

sentences.text: The **customs officer** asked why I was carrying three kilos of dried apricots.
sentences.translation: **Bojxona xodimi** nega uch kilo turshak olib ketayotganimni so'radi.

sentences.text: Hold on, there's a hole in my **trouser pocket** — that's where my keys went!
sentences.translation: To'xta, **shim cho'ntagimda** teshik bor ekan — kalitlarim shu yerdan tushib qolgan!

examples.title: Numbers: **a two-hour journey**, **a five-star hotel**
examples.description: Son + ot aniqlovchi bo'lsa — chiziqcha bilan va -s siz: a ten-pound note. Oddiy ot sifatida esa ko'plik: The journey takes two hours.

sentences.text: It's **a two-hour journey** from Tashkent to Samarkand on the fast train.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Samarqandgacha tezyurar poyezdda **ikki soatlik yo'l**.

sentences.text: Can you change **a twenty-pound note**? I need coins for the parking meter.
sentences.translation: **Yigirma funtlik pulni** maydalab bera olasizmi? Parkovka avtomati uchun tanga kerak.

sentences.text: They stayed in **a five-star hotel**, but the service was surprisingly poor.
sentences.translation: Ular **besh yulduzli mehmonxonada** to'xtashdi, lekin xizmat kutilmaganda yomon edi.

sentences.text: Our office is **a ten-minute walk** from the metro station.
sentences.translation: Ofisimiz metro bekatidan **o'n daqiqalik piyoda yo'l**.

sentences.text: **A three-year-old boy** was found safe and well after going missing in the park.
sentences.translation: Bog'da yo'qolib qolgan **uch yashar bola** sog'-salomat topildi.

sentences.text: My son is only **three years old**, but he already knows the whole alphabet.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim endigina **uch yoshda**, lekin allaqachon butun alifboni biladi.

sentences.text: The flight to London takes **seven hours**, so it's **a seven-hour flight** without a stop.
sentences.translation: Londonga parvoz **yetti soat** davom etadi, ya'ni bu to'xtovsiz **yetti soatlik parvoz**.

sentences.text: The company has signed **a three-year contract** with a German supplier.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya nemis yetkazib beruvchisi bilan **uch yillik shartnoma** imzoladi.

sentences.text: Is there **a twenty-four-hour pharmacy** anywhere near here?
sentences.translation: Bu yerga yaqin **kecha-kunduz ishlaydigan dorixona** bormi?

sentences.text: They're building **a forty-storey tower** in the city centre, with a restaurant on the top floor.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazida **qirq qavatli bino** qurishyapti, uning eng yuqori qavatida restoran bo'ladi.

examples.title: **a wine glass** or **a glass of wine**?
examples.description: Ot + ot — narsaning turi yoki vazifasi (a coffee cup — qahva finjoni). of bilan — ichidagi narsa yoki miqdor (a cup of coffee — bir finjon qahva).

sentences.text: Could I have **a glass of water**, please? I'm really thirsty.
sentences.translation: Bir **stakan suv** bersangiz bo'ladimi? Juda chanqadim.

sentences.text: We need six more **wine glasses** for the dinner party on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Shanbadagi kechki ziyofat uchun yana oltita **vino qadahi** kerak.

sentences.text: Madina drinks **three cups of coffee** a day, which is probably too many.
sentences.translation: Madina kuniga **uch finjon qahva** ichadi, bu, ehtimol, juda ko'p.

sentences.text: These **coffee cups** were a wedding present from my aunt in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bu **qahva finjonlari** Buxorodagi xolamning to'y sovg'asi edi.

sentences.text: Have you got **a box of matches**? The gas cooker won't light.
sentences.translation: **Bir quti gugurtingiz** bormi? Gaz plitasi yonmayapti.

sentences.text: My grandfather collected **matchboxes** from every country he visited.
sentences.translation: Bobom borgan har bir mamlakatidan **gugurt qutilari** to'plagan.

sentences.text: Oliver came back from the market with **a bag of shopping** in each hand.
sentences.translation: Oliver bozordan har bir qo'lida **bir sumkadan xarid** bilan qaytdi.

sentences.text: Take a **shopping bag** with you, because the shop charges for plastic ones.
sentences.translation: O'zingiz bilan **xarid sumkasini** oling, chunki do'kon plastik paketlar uchun pul oladi.

sentences.text: I ate **a whole plate of plov**, and now I can't move!
sentences.translation: **Bir likop to'la palovni** yeb qo'ydim, endi qimirlay olmayapman!

sentences.text: Is that **a tea bag** or **a bag of tea** you've brought back from Sri Lanka?
sentences.translation: Shri-Lankadan olib kelganing **choy paketchasimi** yoki **bir xalta choymi**?

examples.title: Mixed: longer noun phrases in the news
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: uch va undan ortiq otdan iborat birikmalar, son + ot va ot + ot — yangiliklar va ish hayotida.

sentences.text: The **city council** has approved a new **bus lane** on Amir Temur Avenue.
sentences.translation: **Shahar kengashi** Amir Temur shoh ko'chasida yangi **avtobus yo'lagini** tasdiqladi.

sentences.text: A **road safety campaign** for young drivers starts next month across the country.
sentences.translation: Yosh haydovchilar uchun **yo'l xavfsizligi aksiyasi** kelasi oy butun mamlakat bo'ylab boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Our **university exchange programme** sends twenty students to Edinburgh every year.
sentences.translation: **Universitetimizning almashinuv dasturi** har yili yigirma talabani Edinburgga yuboradi.

sentences.text: The **hospital car park** is closed for repairs, so visitors should use the side street.
sentences.translation: **Kasalxona avtoturargohi** ta'mirlash uchun yopiq, shuning uchun tashrif buyuruvchilar yon ko'chadan foydalanishi kerak.

sentences.text: **Train ticket prices** are going up by ten per cent from January.
sentences.translation: Yanvardan **poyezd chiptalari narxi** o'n foizga oshadi.

sentences.text: After **a twelve-hour shift** at the hospital, Nilufar just wanted to sleep.
sentences.translation: Kasalxonadagi **o'n ikki soatlik smenadan** keyin Nilufar faqat uxlashni xohlardi.

sentences.text: We're looking for an experienced **computer programmer** with good **communication skills**.
sentences.translation: Yaxshi **muloqot ko'nikmalariga** ega tajribali **kompyuter dasturchisini** qidiryapmiz.

sentences.text: The **winter sports equipment** in that shop is cheaper than anywhere else in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: O'sha do'kondagi **qishki sport anjomlari** Toshkentning boshqa joylaridagidan arzonroq.

sentences.text: Has anyone seen the **TV remote control**? It was on the sofa a minute ago.
sentences.translation: **Televizor pultini** kimdir ko'rdimi? Bir daqiqa oldin divan ustida edi.

sentences.text: A **ten-day study tour** of Oxford and London costs about two thousand pounds, including flights.
sentences.translation: Oksford va Londonga **o'n kunlik o'quv safari** parvozlar bilan birga taxminan ikki ming funt turadi.
